description_en: Creates an apiKey or mcpHeader credential in a workspace for agents or MCP to access external services. The credential content is submitted as a JSON string, and masked results are returned when queried
description_zh: 在工作空间中创建 apiKey 或 mcpHeader 凭证，供智能体或 MCP 访问外部服务。凭证内容使用 JSON 字符串提交，查询时返回脱敏结果
name: CreateCredential

fields.help_en: The credential content, submitted as a JSON string. For the apiKey type, it contains only a non-empty apiKey. For the mcpHeader type, it contains a non-empty headers array, where each item contains a name and a value
fields.help_zh: 凭证内容，以 JSON 字符串提交。apiKey 类型仅包含非空 apiKey；mcpHeader 类型包含非空 headers 数组，每项包含 name 和 value
fields.name: credential_metadata

fields.help_en: The credential type. Valid values: apiKey (API key) and mcpHeader (MCP request header)
fields.help_zh: 凭证类型，支持 apiKey（API 密钥）和 mcpHeader（MCP 请求头）
fields.name: credential_type

fields.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key
fields.help_en: The credential description. It can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The credential name. It must be unique within the workspace, contain only letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens, and be 3 to 99 characters in length. Runtime reserved names cannot be used
fields.help_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~99 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The ID of the applicable MCP service
fields.help_zh: 适用的 MCP 服务 ID
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The resource name. This field is empty if the resource is deleted
fields.help_zh: 资源名称，资源已删除时为空
fields.name: resource_name

fields.help_en: The resource type. Currently, only mcpServer is supported, which indicates an MCP service
fields.help_zh: 资源类型，当前为 mcpServer，表示 MCP 服务
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: The list of applicable resources for the MCP header credential. This field must be non-empty when resourceScope is set to SPECIFIED, and must be omitted when resourceScope is set to ALL
fields.help_zh: MCP Header 凭证的适用资源列表；resourceScope=SPECIFIED 时必须非空，ALL 时省略
fields.name: resource_refs

fields.help_en: The applicable scope of the MCP header credential. This field is supported only for the mcpHeader type. ALL indicates all MCP services, and SPECIFIED indicates the MCP services specified in resourceRefs. Do not submit this field for the apiKey type
fields.help_zh: MCP Header 凭证的适用范围。仅 mcpHeader 类型支持；ALL 表示全部 MCP 服务，SPECIFIED 表示 resourceRefs 中指定的 MCP 服务。apiKey 类型不提交此字段
fields.name: resource_scope

parameters.help_en: The request body for creating a credential
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The information about the created credential

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

credentialMetadata.description_en: The masked result of the credential content. For the apiKey type, a masked key is returned. For the mcpHeader type, only header names are returned, and values are not returned
credentialMetadata.description_zh: 凭证内容的脱敏结果。apiKey 类型返回密钥掩码；mcpHeader 类型仅返回 Header 名称，不返回值

credentialType.description_en: The credential type. Valid values: apiKey (API key) and mcpHeader (MCP request header)
credentialType.description_zh: 凭证类型，支持 apiKey（API 密钥）和 mcpHeader（MCP 请求头）

description.description_en: The credential description. It can be up to 256 characters in length
description.description_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
description.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key

name.description_en: The credential name. It must be unique within the workspace, contain only letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens, and be 3 to 99 characters in length. Runtime reserved names cannot be used
name.description_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~99 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

resourceRefs.description_en: The list of MCP services to which the credential applies
resourceRefs.description_zh: 凭证适用的 MCP 服务列表

resourceId.description_en: The ID of the applicable MCP service
resourceId.description_zh: 适用的 MCP 服务 ID

resourceName.description_en: The resource name. This field is empty if the resource is deleted
resourceName.description_zh: 资源名称，资源已删除时为空

resourceType.description_en: The resource type. Currently, only mcpServer is supported, which indicates an MCP service
resourceType.description_zh: 资源类型，当前为 mcpServer，表示 MCP 服务

resourceRefs.title_en: 凭证可应用的资源列表
resourceRefs.title_zh: 凭证可应用的资源列表

resourceScope.description_en: The applicable scope of the credential. ALL indicates all scopes, and SPECIFIED indicates the specified MCP services
resourceScope.description_zh: 凭证适用范围。ALL 表示全部范围，SPECIFIED 表示指定的 MCP 服务

updatedAt.description_en: The last modification time in RFC 3339 UTC format
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
